description.value: LR Pizza & Curry is a Burnaby fast-food restaurant that fuses classic Canadian-style pizza with a full South Asian kitchen covering tandoori, curry, and Indo-Chinese dishes — an unusually broad menu under one roof. Unique offerings like Desi Style pizzas (Tandoori Chicken, Palak Paneer, Shahi Paneer) sit alongside extensive beef, lamb, and seafood curries, giving cyclists a substantial and varied refuelling option. Indoor seating is confirmed via OSM.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active restaurant with online ordering, a full Indian curry and pizza menu, and contact details; the address on the website (7571 6th St, Burnaby, BC V3N3M4) matches OSM. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned on the website or in any OSM tags, so all required criteria are null. The website copyright footer spells the name 'LR PIZZA & CURREY LTD.' (Currey) while OSM uses 'LR Pizza & Curry', flagged as a minor name discrepancy.
concerns: Name spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'LR Pizza & Curry' but the website copyright footer reads 'LR PIZZA & CURREY LTD.' (Currey vs Curry) — the legal registered name appears to differ from the common trading name.
Phone number 604-522-5000 is present on the website but absent from OSM tags; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there was no OSM value to corroborate.
